description: New rooftop plant and machinery in replacement roof structure, creation of rooftop terrace, new ground floor entrances to Silbury Street and replacement of windows to all levels.
decision_conditions: <p>No live music, amplified music, or public announcement system shall be used within the external rooftop terrace area hereby permitted.&nbsp;<br>REASON: To protect the amenity of the area.</p>

<p>Unless otherwise hereby approved, all new works in respect of all the works hereby approved and any other incidental works to be carried out in this connection shall match the existing building in respect of materials used, detailed execution and finished appearance.</p><p><br></p><p>REASON: To ensure a satisfactory external appearance and preserve the significance of the conservation area.</p>

<p><span style="color: rgb(51, 51, 51);">Notwithstanding the details shown on the plans and documents hereby approved, full particulars of the following shall be submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority prior to commencement of the relevant part of works. The development shall not be carried out otherwise than in accordance with the details thus approved.&nbsp; </span></p><p><span style="color: rgb(51, 51, 51);">i) Full details of proposed windows and doors, including a 1:20 scale elevation drawing of each window type showing the glazing pattern and 1:5 scale vertical and horizontal cross section drawings showing the upper and lower stiles, the meeting rails, the dimensions of the glazing, the profile and dimensions of the glazing bars and spacers (if any).&nbsp;</span></p><p><span style="color: rgb(51, 51, 51);">ii) Full details, including a schedule of materials, of all hard landscaping</span></p><p><span style="color: rgb(51, 51, 51);"> All approved details shall be carried out in accordance with the approved plans and shall be maintained and retained in situ.&nbsp; </span></p><p><span style="color: rgb(51, 51, 51);">REASON: To ensure that the external appearance of the building is satisfactory and does not detract from the character and visual amenity of the conservation area.</span></p>

The Development hereby permitted shall only be carried out and completed strictly in accordance with the submitted plans hereby approved and any subsequent approval of details.


REASON: To ensure that the development hereby permitted is carried out in full accordance with the plans hereby approved.

<p>Any new plant shall be installed, together with any associated ancillary
equipment, so as to prevent the transmission of noise and vibration into neighbouring
premises. The rated noise level from all plant and ancillary equipment shall not increase the
existing background noise level (10dB below) when measured 1m external from the nearest
residential or noise sensitive premises. An assessment of the expected noise levels shall be
carried out by a suitably qualified (IOA accredited) and experienced acoustic consultant, in
accordance with BS 4142:2014+A1:2019 ‘Methods for rating and assessing industrial and
commercial sound,’ and any mitigation measures necessary to achieve the above required
noise levels shall be submitted to the Local Planning Authority in writing for approval.
The plant shall thereafter be installed and maintained in accordance with the approved details.</p><p>REASON: To protect acceptable local noise levels.</p>

<p>A post installation noise assessment report that demonstrates the noise levels
from the relocated 6 plant and machinery when running simultaneously shall be 10dB(A)
or more below the background noise level when measured at 1m from any nearby noise
sensitive premises at any time. The assessment of the expected noise levels shall be carried
out by a suitably qualified (IOA accredited) and experienced acoustic consultant, in
accordance with BS 4142:2014+A1:2019 ‘Methods for rating and assessing industrial and
commercial sound,’ and any mitigation measures necessary to achieve the above required
noise levels shall be submitted to the Local Planning Authority in writing for approval.
Reason: To protect the amenities of adjoining occupiers and the surrounding area.</p><p>REASON: To protect acceptable noise levels.</p>

The development hereby permitted must be begun not later than the expiration of three years beginning with the date of this permission.


REASON: In order to comply with the provisions of the Town and Country Planning Act 1990 (as amended).
